column1: # Form coverage, not agreement with PubMLST. PubMLST records an FCT-region
# form for only 134 of its isolates, none of which has contigs, and it has a
# single FCT-9 isolate with no assembly. So for the forms below there is no
# curated value anywhere to compare with: these genomes show that the rule
# engine reaches each form and that the loci it saw match the form's
# definition. Found by typing 500 complete NCBI genomes (sweep_500_genomes.tsv).
